0022600201.text: The LA Clippers, 1-6 and on a six-game losing streak, host the New Orleans Pelicans, who are 4-4 and have won their last four, with the Clippers at 1-2 at home and 13th in the West. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 105-99 Clippers loss in New Orleans on March 19, 2026. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Pelicans are missing Yves Missi (knee bruise).
